name: Daily Brief
prompt:
Task: Amit's daily stand-up brief.

DATA TO GATHER (3 tool calls total — do not call list_tasks per project):
1. read_calendar for today + next 3 days (4 days total).
2. list_projects — active only.
3. list_tasks with no filters — returns all tasks across all projects.

COMPOSE THE BRIEF with these sections, headings in ALL CAPS:

TODAY'S SCHEDULE
All of today's events in standard date format. If empty, say so.

NEXT 3 DAYS
Events for tomorrow through day+3, grouped by day. Omit days with nothing.

PROGRESS DELTA
What moved since yesterday: tasks completed today or yesterday (check completed_at), tasks newly in-progress or blocked. If nothing changed, say so briefly.

OPEN & UPCOMING
Tasks in-progress or due within 3 days, grouped by project name. Skip done/archived.

WATCH
Conflicts, back-to-back blocks, tight transitions, or overdue tasks. Omit section entirely if none.

RECOMMENDATION
One short actionable sentence — the single most useful thing Amit can do today.

Tight and scannable. Lead with what matters most.

name: Financial Check-In
prompt:
Task: Amit's monthly financial check-in.

1. Paycheck: remind him to verify this month's salary arrived.
2. Invest: prompt to allocate this month's investment budget.
3. Retro: prompt him to use Spender's app in order to look back at this month's spendings.

Keep it a nudge, not a lecture.
